result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but one prominent restaurant card shows a broken/missing image, and the fixed bottom navigation appears to obscure lower content.

issues.description: The large image area for “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” displays a generic broken-image placeholder instead of restaurant imagery, leaving a prominent blank gray card.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image asset or loading logic, and provide a fallback restaurant image rather than a broken-image icon.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower portion of the next restaurant card image, potentially hiding content when the user reaches the bottom of the list.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can be fully viewed above the navigation bar.
